errors.description: There is an isolated arithmetic error: with u=1/(2^{n+1}-1), (1-u)/2=(2^n-1)/(2^{n+1}-1), not the displayed value. The subsequent bound on Liu follows correctly directly from D(A)≤u, so the proof is readily repaired.

parsed.notes: The reduction, geometric lower bound, graph/tree argument, and subset-sum cross-pairing upper bound are otherwise rigorous and establish the claimed optimum.
